name: at-home cure tinnitus

phase_0.boundary_condition: The threshold of perceptual habituation where the brain filters the phantom sound.

VINIT.justification: The initial state of unfiltered phantom ringing before any diagnostic or therapeutic framework is applied.

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary of the cured state where the brain successfully ignores the phantom sound.

AFWD.justification: The forward application of external noise to drive neural adaptation and mask the ringing.

AREV.justification: The reverse descent from physical tension in the TMJ and neck that exacerbates the ringing.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of masking, relaxation, and cognitive behavioral shifts into a continuous practice.

IMSCRIB.justification: The auditory cortex recognizing its own filtering process and re-identifying the sound as neutral.

FSPLIT.justification: Splits the unified auditory experience into distinct diagnostic pathways: Sensorineural (cochlear/neural) and Somatic (physical tension).

FFUSE.justification: Reconstitutes the unified auditory experience from both treated pathways, restoring holistic hearing.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative success state where the brain filters the sound and it becomes less intrusive.

EVALF.justification: The negative failure state where physical tension remains a trigger and the sound dominates attention.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice of hearing a sound that isn't physically there; holding physical silence and perceptual noise simultaneously without resolution.

IFIX.justification: The permanent clinical baseline of hearing thresholds and tinnitus frequency, irreversibly logged.

phase_3.void_description: Unassessed ringing; no diagnostic or therapeutic framework applied.
phase_3.true_description: Habituated state; the brain actively filters the phantom sound.
phase_3.false_description: Distressed state; the ringing dominates attention and causes anxiety.
phase_3.both_description: The phantom paradox; the patient is in a quiet room but hears the ringing, holding physical silence and perceptual noise.

steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with the Tinnitus Baseline (the phantom ringing).
Record the Audiometric Record as a permanent clinical baseline of hearing thresholds.
Apply Etiology Branching to split the Unified Auditory Experience into Sensorineural Pathway and Somatic Pathway.
Apply Sound Therapy to the Sensorineural Pathway to drive forward neural adaptation.
Evaluate Perceptual Fading on the T-arm to confirm the sound is becoming less intrusive.
Apply Somatic Release to the Somatic Pathway to descend from TMJ and neck tension.
Evaluate Intrusive Persistence on the F-arm to check if physical tension remains a trigger.
Apply Integrated Relief to fuse the Sensorineural Pathway and Somatic Pathway back into the Unified Auditory Experience.
Enter the Phantom Paradox, holding the physical absence of sound and the perceptual presence of the ring simultaneously without resolution.
Apply Neuroplastic Re-mapping as the auditory cortex self-identifies the sound as neutral and re-maps its own filtering.
Compose the Habituation Protocol by chaining sound therapy, somatic release, and cognitive shifts.
Terminate at the Habituation Threshold, the closed boundary where the brain successfully ignores the phantom sound.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Attentional focus and metabolic energy for neural filtering
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Hyper-vigilant state tracking the phantom ringing
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Habituated state where the brain filters the sound automatically
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The transition from hyper-vigilance to habituation conserves neural energy by replacing active distress with passive filtering.
